listings.name: The Central Coast Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Locally grown farm produce alongside artisan food, bakery stalls and coffee/brew, as described on the market's site.

hours.note: Described as an all-weather event, rain or shine.

listings.description: A weekly Sunday market at Gosford Showground selling locally grown farm produce and artisan food.
listings.caveats: Own site copyright line says 2025; the Visit NSW listing shows the event running weekly from 15 Nov 2026. Other listings gave older or different domains and a 1pm finish; the market's own 7am-12pm used.

listings.name: Lismore Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Also plants, mulch and compost, nuts, salami, bread, pastries, preserves, ferments and breakfast/coffee.

hours.note: The NSW Government event page lists individual Saturday dates; a few Saturdays (for example 23 May 2026) are not listed.

listings.hoursAsStated: Saturdays, 7:30am to 11:30am (individual dates listed on the NSW Government events page through December 2026).
listings.description: A Saturday-morning market with fruit and vegetable growers and other local producers, with undercover shopping.
listings.caveats: Only website given by the official page is a Facebook page. Page says check with organiser for latest times.

listings.name: Mullum Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Stallholder categories on the site include vegetables, fruit and herbs, honey, artisan condiments and native bushfoods; the site describes fresh organic produce from local farmers.

hours.note: Site notes a change to Wednesday 23 December 2026 (Christmas Day falls on a Friday) and open on Friday 1 January 2027.

listings.description: A weekly Friday market at the Mullumbimby Showgrounds where local farmers sell fresh produce directly.
listings.caveats: Site announcement was dated 9 Nov 2026. 'Organic' is described generally; no certification per stallholder was verified, so no tags.

listings.name: Torquay Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Also meat, artisan cheeses and breads, smoked fish, salami, olive oil, jams, preserves, nuts and coffee. Described as plastic-bag free.
listings.description: A weekly Saturday market selling local fresh produce and artisan foods.
listings.caveats: Market's own website not located; website field is the regional tourism listing. Phone appears only on tourism pages so left blank. Meat type not stated so not tagged.

listings.name: Bendigo Community Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Also herbs, meat, bread, cheese, wine, olives, baked goods and dumplings.

hours.note: Second Saturday of each month, 9am to 12.30pm (not expressible as weekly days).

listings.hoursAsStated: The second Saturday of each month from 9am - 12.30pm.
listings.description: A monthly market where regional farmers sell seasonal produce directly.
listings.caveats: Other listings place it at the Bendigo Pony Club (Breen St and Belle Vue Rd) 9am-1pm; the official regional tourism page's venue and times used. Days left empty because monthly.

listings.name: The Berry Dairy
listings.otherProducts: Pick-your-own strawberries (described as spray-free), farm cafe with real fruit ice cream, animal farmyard.

hours.note: Closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Kitchen last orders 3pm; seasonal October to May.

listings.hoursAsStated: Open Thursday-Monday, 10am-4.30pm (kitchen last orders 3pm); Fridays open until 6pm; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; seasonal October-May.
listings.description: A family-run pick-your-own strawberry farm and farm cafe in Gippsland, open for the 2026 season.
listings.caveats: Farm Pass entry applies to picking. Site shows 'now open for the season'.

listings.name: Ripe 'N' Ready Cherry Farm
listings.otherProducts: Pick-your-own cherries; farm shop with cherries, berries, garlic, cherry juice and other seasonal produce.

hours.note: Last orchard entry 4pm; closes 4pm on New Year's Eve. Cherry picking opens from mid-November to January, weather and fruit dependent.

listings.hoursAsStated: 9.00 am - 5.00 pm 7 days a week; pick-your-own cherries open mid-November to January.
listings.description: A Mornington Peninsula cherry and berry farm with a farm shop and pick-your-own cherries in season.
listings.caveats: Page does not carry a dated 2026 notice; picking start is described as mid-November and depends on the fruit. Site copyright runs to 2027.

listings.name: Hillwood Berries (Pick Your Own farm and farmgate cafe)
listings.otherProducts: Pick-your-own berries, berry-inspired cafe, fruit wines, vinegars and jams.

hours.note: Hours quoted are for the farmgate cafe; the site says to follow Facebook for seasonal opening hours.

listings.hoursAsStated: Cafe is open everyday from 10am - 4pm. Follow us on Facebook for frequent updates on our offering and seasonal opening hours.
listings.description: A pick-your-own berry farm near Launceston with an on-site farmgate cafe.
listings.caveats: Picking hours are not separately stated; the working farm at 139 Hillwood Road is by appointment only.

listings.name: Touchwood Farm Goat Dairy
listings.otherProducts: Goat milk soap and lotions, goat cheese and seasonal farm produce, per the Huon Valley Council directory.

hours.note: The council directory lists Thursday to Sunday 10am-4pm instead.

listings.hoursAsStated: Own site: from 11am to 4pm Sundays. Council directory: Thursdays to Sundays 10am to 4pm.
listings.description: A goat dairy farm in the Huon Valley selling goat products directly from the farm gate.
listings.caveats: Own site and council differ on hours; own site used. Confirm before visiting.

listings.name: Bowral Honey Farm
listings.otherProducts: Working apiary with hands-on tours and honey tastings; the listing does not itemise what is sold.
listings.hoursAsStated: Trading Hours Sat & Sun from 10am to 4pm.
listings.description: A working apiary at Retford Park open weekends for tours and honey tastings.
listings.caveats: Own domain did not load; hours are from the Visit Southern Highlands operator listing. Sale of honey for takeaway is not itemised there, so products left empty. Postcode not on the opened page.

listings.name: Meredith Farm Produce Store and Cafe
listings.otherProducts: Cheese, yoghurts, meats, preserves and drinks from the Meredith Dairy farm, plus a cafe.
listings.hoursAsStated: Closed Monday and Tuesday; Wednesday to Sunday 8:30am to 3:30pm.
listings.description: A shop and cafe selling food from the Meredith Dairy farm.
listings.caveats: A 2024 local news article gave 9am start; the current tourism listing's 8:30am used. Phone is on tourism page only.

listings.name: Myrtlebank Roaming Farms Farmgate (The Chook House)
listings.otherProducts: Online shop lists ready-to-eat meals, baked goods, fresh produce, pantry items and vegetables as well.

hours.note: Own site: open daily, 7.30am to 7.30pm. Wellington Shire tourism page lists 7am-8pm.

listings.hoursAsStated: Open 365 days a year, from 7.30am to 7.30pm.
listings.description: A farm shop selling eggs from the farm's free-range hens and grass-fed Black Angus beef.
listings.caveats: Wellington Shire page shows 7am-8pm; own site's hours used.

listings.name: Bilpin Fruit Bowl
listings.otherProducts: Shop stocks local honey, homemade jams, souvenirs and fresh seasonal fruit; pick-your-own when fruit is available.

hours.note: Farm picking 10am-3pm when fruit is available; the site says to call ahead.

listings.hoursAsStated: Cafe and shop open 7 days, 8:00am-5:00pm. Farm 10:00am-3:00pm when fruit is available for picking.
listings.description: A roadside fruit shop and orchard on Bells Line of Road with pick-your-own fruit in season.
listings.caveats: Older page said it closes only on Christmas Day; picking depends on seasonal fruit.

unverified.name: SAGE Farmers Market Moruya
unverified.why: Own site and NSW Government page confirm every Tuesday afternoon from 3pm at Riverside Park, Moruya NSW 2537, but no finish time is stated.

unverified.name: Mudgee Farmers' Market
unverified.why: Visit Mudgee Region confirms Robertson Park, Market Street, with 21 Nov and 19 Dec 2026 dates, but still shows no opening hours.

unverified.name: Coal Creek Farmers Market
unverified.why: Visit Gippsland confirms second Saturday monthly (14 Nov, 12 Dec 2026) at 12 Silkstone Rd, Korumburra 3950, but no hours on the page.

unverified.name: Metung Farmers Market
unverified.why: Visit Gippsland shows second Saturday monthly (14 Nov, 12 Dec 2026) at 60 Metung Road, but no hours on the page.

unverified.name: Blackheath Growers Market
unverified.why: NSW Government page: mornings until noon, second Sunday monthly Feb-Dec, corner Gardiner Crescent and Great Western Highway; no start time.

unverified.name: Springwood Growers Market
unverified.why: Visit NSW lists monthly at Blue Mountains Theatre and Community Hub, 106-108 Macquarie Road; no hours on the page.

unverified.name: Bob's Gardenfarm Shop
unverified.why: Wellington Shire page describes the farmgate (28 Dessents Rd) but its hours display was ambiguous and its own site gave no hours.

unverified.name: Wilbert's Veggies & Cackleberries
unverified.why: Council page lists eggs and vegetables at 224 Myrtlebank Rd, but hours looked like a template default (identical to another listing).

unverified.why: Only a search snippet; page did not load.
